_comments.purpose: Phase 2.5 — Superwall + StoreKit iOS subscription integration requires a custom Expo dev client (NOT Expo Go) because @superwall/react-native-superwall ships native iOS code (SuperwallKit-Pod) that Expo Go cannot dynamically link.
_comments.development_simulator: The 'development-simulator' profile produces an unsigned iOS Simulator build (.app bundle, not .ipa) that loads the Expo dev menu and can hot-reload JS. This is the canonical local dev loop for Phase 2.5: build once with EAS or `expo run:ios`, then iterate JS via `expo start --dev-client`.
_comments.development_device: The 'development' profile produces a signed development-client .ipa for installation on physical iOS devices via TestFlight or ad-hoc distribution. Used for ASC sandbox subscription testing where the simulator's StoreKit configuration would not exercise the real receipt validation surface.
_comments.android_out_of_scope: Android billing is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for Phase 2.5 per the Seed contract (iOS-only). The Android entries below are placeholders so EAS Build does not reject the file shape; they are not invoked by any package.json script in this phase.
